QuestInfo.name: Forgotten
QuestInfo.0: You returned to Fox Point Village, but the foxes are treating you oddly. Ask Chief Silver what happened.
QuestInfo.1: Silver is acting so strange... Surely he didn't forget about you, too? Maybe it's just his age. And maybe the other foxes are playing a prank on you. Maybe... Maybe...
QuestInfo.2: The foxes don't remember you either. Is it not just Maple World? Are you destined to be forgotten wherever you go?

speech.0: Oh geez, monster! Earless, tailless monster! Please, please don't eat me! I really don't taste good!
Go away, monster! We don't want to eat you, but we will if we have to!
How dare you come here! Scram! I'll make kebabs out of you if you don't beat it.
Huh? What's going on here? How'd you get all the way out here? This is fox territory, child. You should scoot before you end up a snack.
Please, just leave. We don't like fights. If you're hungry, hunt somewhere else. Just leave us alone.

0.msg: Hey you, how did you get all the way up here? The Fox God should have kept outsiders like you out! Ugh, look at you with your tiny ears and no tail. Get lost! Go, before we eat you up!

1.msg: (What's going on here? Not even Silver remembers... Oh, no. Please, no...)

0.msg: (Silver... Silver's old, so he might have just forgotten naturally. The other foxes will surely be kind.)
(Everything that happened before is...happening again? Why? Surely this is a prank...)\r\n

1.0: You're still here? D-don't try anything funny, outsider. We'll eat you. We will!

default.0: I don't know what brought you here, but there's nothing for you. Just go.
